jobs.title: Associate, Client Service & Operations
jobs.description: The Associate, Client Service and Operations supports the Institutional Sales team by coordinating the onboarding, ongoing servicing, and retention of institutional clients. The role serves as a primary day-to-day service contact and internal coordinator, ensuring that client requirements are accurately documented, communicated, and delivered across Institutional Sales, Portfolio Management, Investment Operations, Compliance, Legal, Product, Finance, custodians, recordkeepers, and other service providers. The associate leads the servicing components of the client lifecycle, including onboarding execution, account administration, client reporting, inquiry management, service reviews, issue resolution, and account transitions. The role proactively identifies service risks, tracks commitments through completion, and provides timely client intelligence to Institutional Sales to support strong relationships, asset retention, and growth opportunities. Key Accountabilities Client Onboarding and Implementation • Coordinate end-to-end onboarding of new institutional clients, accounts, products, and mandates. • Maintain onboarding plans, checklists, dependencies, owners, approvals, target dates, and outstanding-item logs. • Coordinate legal, AML/KYC, compliance, tax, operational, reporting, invoicing, account-opening, funding-readiness, and system-setup requirements. • Proactively identify risks to agreed launch dates, escalate delays, and provide clear status updates to clients, Institutional Sales, and internal stakeholders. • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready onboarding records and approvals in designated repositories. Day-to-Day Client Service • Serve as a primary service contact for assigned institutional clients, consultants, and authorized representatives. • Respond to inquiries accurately and promptly, coordinating internal action and tracking requests through resolution. • Coordinate account information, statements, reports, invoices, contributions, withdrawals, transfers, contacts, authorized signatories, and other account-maintenance requests. • Anticipate client needs and ensure commitments are completed within agreed timelines. Client Reporting • Coordinate the preparation, quality review, and delivery of monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc client reporting. • Validate reporting recipients, delivery instructions, distribution lists, and client preferences. • Coordinate fee-invoice delivery and support resolution of reporting and invoicing inquiries. Service Delivery, Escalation and Retention Support • Act as the central coordinator for operational and servicing matters affecting assigned clients. • Establish clear issue ownership, actions, target dates, escalation points, and communication plans. • Monitor recurring inquiries, missed commitments, reporting failures, service delays, and other indicators of potential client dissatisfaction. • Communicate service concerns, changing needs, stakeholder changes, retention risks, and potential expansion signals to Institutional Sales. • Support client service reviews through service metrics, open-item logs, incident summaries, remediation updates, and documented actions. CRM, Governance and Process Improvement • Maintain complete and timely client records in Salesforce and other designated systems, including contacts, meeting notes, commitments, risks, issues, and actions. • Coordinate ongoing mandate and account changes, client transitions, and account closures. • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, standardize templates, strengthen controls, and reduce manual handoffs or duplicate client requests. • Support audits, control testing, regulatory inquiries, and maintenance of audit-ready evidence. • Provide backup coverage, share knowledge, and support training of new team members. Qualifications • Four to six years of relevant experience and a post-secondary degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education

jobs.title: Events & Marketing Coordinator, Remote Job
jobs.description: About Us Eterio Realities Inc. is a software company in Victoria, British Columbia, building augmented reality tools for industrial manufacturing. Our story began in 2010, out of challenges encountered during the construction of the Sparkling Hill Resort in Vernon, B.C. Today we're a team of 30+ across Canada and India, and growing! We have built FabStation, an AR-enabled manufacturing execution system used by 250+ fabrication shops in 30+ countries. FabStation replaces paper and 2D drawings on the shop floor with AR-guided assembly, dimensional inspection, and production tracking, and it integrates with the workflows shops already run. Our mission is to empower steel fabricators with innovative augmented reality technology, revolutionizing the way they work. What We Are Looking For We are seeking a detail-oriented Marketing Coordinator (Event Management and Social Media) to manage and coordinate FabStation's participation in industry trade shows from end to end. You will also help shape our social strategy and maintain quarterly social calendars across LinkedIn and other channels. This role focuses on maintaining a strong brand presence on social media, particularly LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. You'll work closely with the Marketing and Sales Managers to create and run promotional initiatives that build brand awareness and help grow the sales pipeline. What You Will Do Event Management (Trade Shows and Virtual Events) • Manage a yearly calendar of FabStation's trade show participation. Handle new event requests and book all events in a timely manner. • Make sure every part of trade show and event booking runs smoothly and give leadership weekly updates on upcoming events. • Work directly with the sales and marketing team on day-to-day trade show arrangements, including booking booths, logistics, printing, digital campaigns, and general administrative support. • Communicate independently with internal and external partners attending trade shows and get them information in a timely manner. • Coordinate and fulfill incoming marketing requests, prioritizing those aligned with lead generation and sales objectives. Social Media and Content • Manage and execute the social media calendar for LinkedIn and Instagram. • Post engaging, brand-consistent content across LinkedIn, Instagram and other relevant platforms on a regular weekly schedule. • Produce engaging video content for LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms, using AI tools as a core part of your workflow. • Work with videographer to create short-form and long-form videos for trade shows, the website, and promotional campaigns using internal video shoots, AI-generated clips, and product videos. • Coordinate marketing efforts, including print advertising, brochures, and direct mail. • Design graphics for digital tiles, social posts, and digital invitations using Canva and AI tools (e.g., Claude). What We're Looking For • At least 2 years of relevant experience in event coordination and social media management in a B2B environment. • Strong experience organizing and coordinating events, from planning to execution. • Knowledge of HubSpot (or other CRMs), Canva, CapCut, Descript, and other video editing tools. • Ability to use AI tools such as Claude or Copilot in daily workflows, from running reports to creating new content. • Willingness to learn new content creation tools, send surveys, and arrange customer interviews. • Ability to create promotional content and develop marketing assets (videos, flyers, brochures, invitations). • Versatility and initiative, with the ability to manage several priorities at once. • Some travel is required. What We Offer • Competitive compensation: $55,000-65,000 CAD • Comprehensive benefits • 2 weeks paid vacation plus 5 paid sick days • Annual company offsite • $2,000 CAD tech stipend • Fully remote work environment • Company-wide holiday week closure over Christmas • Continuous coaching for career growth Thank you to all appl
